title: drafter doc set outline
description: A project's outline.yaml: the page types and every page of the doc set.

types.description: The page types the doc set declares.

name.description: The type name a page's type field uses.

anatomy.description: The anatomy the type follows: a stock anatomy name such as Task guide, or an entry in the register of the track that holds the type's pages. drafter check requires one.

pages.description: Every page of the doc set, in order.

path.description: The page's path, relative to the repository root.

slug.description: The page's short name, used by crossLinks.

type.description: A type the types list declares.

job.description: What the reader accomplishes with the page.

outOfScope.description: What the page leaves to other pages.

figure.description: True for a page that carries a figure, which stays on the docs page chain.

managed.description: False for a page drafter never drafts, such as a historical record. Such an entry needs only its path.

tracks.description: Reader tracks: each groups the pages one reader profile uses. With tracks declared, every managed page matches exactly one.

name.description: The track's name, unique in the outline.

reader.description: The reader profile: who reads these pages and what they bring.

standard.description: The published style standard the track follows. Only google ships.

paths.description: Globs over page paths. A ** segment matches any number of segments.

register.description: A tracked repository path to a register whose "## The page anatomies" section adds anatomy entries beyond the stock ones.

crossLinks.description: Links one page should carry to another.

from.description: A page, by slug or path.

to.description: A page, by slug or path.
